units.source_text: 且说薰中纳言闻知匂亲王闭居在二条院，甚是担心。

en.t: Now Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard that Prince Niou had shut himself away at the Nijo estate, and he was deeply worried.
He thought, "This should never have happened!

units.source_text: 我的用心何等愚蠢恶劣！

en.t: How foolish and shameful my intentions were!

units.source_text: 我本该作为她娘家的后援人去照顾她，岂可忽萌邪念？”

en.t: I ought to have cared for her as a supporter from her own family side; how could I suddenly harbor such improper thoughts?"

units.source_text: 便努力扭转自己的心情，推想匂亲王即使宠爱六女公子，也决不会抛舍二女公子。

en.t: So he tried hard to turn his feelings around, reasoning that even if Prince Niou loved the Sixth Princess, he would surely never abandon the Second Princess.
At that, he felt relieved and glad for the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 他想起二女公子身边的侍女所穿衣服已经陈旧，便走到三公主那里，问道：“母亲这里有没有现成的女装？

en.t: Remembering that the clothes worn by the Second Princess's attendants had grown old and worn, he went to the Third Princess and asked, "Mother, do you have any ready-made women's garments here?

units.source_text: 我有个用处，想要几套呢。”

en.t: I have a use for them, and would like several sets."

units.source_text: 三公主说：“下个月做法事用的白色服装，大概已经做好了。

en.t: The Third Princess said, "The white garments for next month's memorial service have probably already been finished.

units.source_text: 但染色的此刻还未置备。

en.t: But dyed garments have not yet been prepared at the moment.

units.source_text: 你有用处，立刻叫他们缝制吧。”

en.t: If you need them, have them sewn at once."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“那又何必呢！

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "There is no need to go that far!

units.source_text: 并不是重要用处，只须现成的就好了。”

en.t: It is not for anything important; whatever is already on hand will do."

units.source_text: 便吩咐裁缝所的侍女，叫她们拿出几套女装来，又添几件漂亮的褂子，这些都是现成的。

en.t: He then instructed the women in the sewing room to bring out several sets of women's clothing, and added a few handsome jackets as well, all of them ready-made.

units.source_text: 此外又取了些不曾染色的绫绢。

en.t: In addition, he took out some undyed figured silk and plain silk.

units.source_text: 还有给二女公子本人做衣服的，是薰中纳言自己备用的红色砑光绢，又添上许多白绫。

en.t: For garments for the Second Princess herself, he used the red calendered silk that he had kept for his own use, and added a great deal of white damask silk.

units.source_text: 没有做女裙用的衣料，怎么办呢？

en.t: There was no fabric for making a woman's skirt; what was he to do?

units.source_text: 便加了一条腰带，在带上系一首诗：

en.t: So he added a waist sash, and attached a poem to it:
